subject: City Council Newsletter Draft
overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee met to review and amend the draft of the Medford City Council newsletter, ultimately approving the draft with updates on a trash collection resolution, a school solar panel project, and other commemorations.

items.title: Medford City Council Newsletter Draft
items.summary: The committee discussed and approved the draft newsletter with amendments to include details about a November trash collection resolution and a December Committee of the Whole meeting regarding solar panels at the McGlynn School, while allowing the chair to append recent commemorations and acknowledgements.
